up: Retrieve data for assay CHEMBL829152. For each compound with an exact activity measurement (standard_relation = '=') in that assay, return these columns: canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units. Provide all such rows, one per activity measurement.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL829152' AND a.standard_relation = '=';
